name: refined_gulf_coast_greedy
description: Seven-predictor Gulf Coast damaging-wind logistic model reproduced from the final project workbook and analysis pipeline. Real-time guidance uses the full-data fit; reported research skill metrics are 5-fold stratified cross-validation results.

vertical_totals_850_500_c.research_definition: Temperature interpolated to 850 hPa minus temperature interpolated to 500 hPa.

mlcape_jkg.research_definition: MetPy mixed_layer_cape_cin using the lowest 100 hPa of the surface-anchored pressure/temperature/dewpoint profile.

sbli_c.research_definition: MetPy surface parcel profile followed by lifted_index; equivalent fallback is environmental T500 minus surface-parcel T500.

mid_level_lapse_rate_c_km.research_definition: (T700 - T500) divided by the 700-to-500 hPa geopotential-height difference in kilometers.

sfc_3km_lapse_rate_c_km.research_definition: Surface temperature minus temperature interpolated to 3000 m AGL, divided by 3 km.

dcape_jkg.research_definition: MetPy downdraft_cape calculated from the surface-anchored pressure/temperature/dewpoint profile.

thetae_deficit_k.research_definition: Maximum theta-e in the lowest 100 hPa above the actual surface pressure minus minimum theta-e from 700-500 hPa.
